site.title: Klaus Mueller - Stony Brook University - Brookhaven National Laboratory
site.description: Klaus Mueller is a Professor of Computer Science at Stony Brook University and Senior Scientist at Brookhaven National Laboratory, working on human-centered, explainable AI and visualization.
site.name: Klaus Mueller

hero.name: Klaus Mueller

portrait.alt: Klaus Mueller, Professor of Computer Science, Stony Brook University

hero.intro: My research lives at the intersection of visualization, visual analytics and human-centered AI — building systems that help people reason with complex data and understand what machine-learning models are doing.

slides.title: Visual Analytics for Medical Imaging
slides.text: Interactive analysis of brain structure and connectivity for diagnosis, treatment planning, and research.

slides.title: Computational Medical Imaging
slides.text: Quantitative methods for extracting meaningful information from complex medical imaging datasets.

slides.title: Scientific Visualization
slides.text: Translating complex biomedical data into clear, interpretable visual representations.

slides.title: Research & Computational Methods
slides.text: Combining computation, visualization, and quantitative analysis to support biomedical research.

research.heading: Human-Centered AI & Visualization
research.text: I work at the intersection of visualization, AI, and domain sciences, developing methods and interactive systems that help people reason, decide, and act with data and models.

about.description: Hoc ab homine scriptum est, non ab intellegentia artificiali. Omne verbum, omnis sententia atque elocutio ab homine vero proficiscuntur. Fortasse non est ad unguem expolitum neque sine ullo vitio compositum, sed hoc ipsum ad veram eius naturam pertinet. Cogitationem enim, affectus, experientiam proprietatemque humanam refert, non opus a systemate artificioso effectum.
